The complete original proof is delivered at source0.tex lines 1055--1088 (34 adjacent lines). The corollary is the main structural consequence of the paper's Theorem 3.1 (itself delivered as uncounted retained context), and the proof is a genuine research-level argument that assembles the paper's continuous-function-calculus machinery and its norm-completeness criterion.
